question.problem: What is the domain in the $xy$-plane of the elliptic cylinder $\frac{(x-4)^{2}}{4}+\frac{(y-2)^{2}}{36}=1?$

choices.value: An ellipse centered at $(-4,-2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $2$ and $6.$
An ellipse centered at $(4,2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $2$ and $6.$
An ellipse centered at $(2,\sqrt{2})$ with semi-axes of lengths $4$ and $36.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(2,\sqrt{2})$ with semi-axes of lengths $4$ and $36.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(4,2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $2$ and $6.$
